message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: Zhang, a lawyer in a law firm, used his position to modify checks, divert small portion of lawyer fees, and embezzled funds from the firm's account total 94,897.64 RMB. This is misappropriation of funds by a person in a position of trust within a non-state organization. In Chinese criminal law, this is "职务侵占" (embezzlement by a person in a position of trust, i.e., misappropriation of funds). The examples: For similar case of Yang (law firm) they used "职务侵占". Also earlier example: "职务侵占;挪用特定款物". So here it's just "职务侵占". Also there is self-surrender (自首) but that doesn't affect crime name. So answer: [罪名]职务侵占<eoa>.
